args.body:
- Juniper Labware newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter") points subscribers to the blog article and notes the companion piece with full charts is unlocked via the insights link using your work email.
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion): shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Juniper Labware: Freight Pricing Newsletter, Article & Companion
